# LC Skin Beauty ✨

Mask-aware skin cooling and brightening for ComfyUI (LC123). Works in **CIELAB** under an auto (or external) skin mask so backgrounds and most clothing stay out of the grade.

---

## Highlights

- **Skin-first, not whole-frame bleach** — correction follows a skin probability mask  
- **Presets that load the sliders** — pick a starting look, then fine-tune what you see  
- **Eyes & lips protected** — auto mask soft-excludes dark eyes and strong lip red  
- **Fabric-aware auto mask** — high local pattern variance is suppressed (prints/weaves)  
- **Highlight & texture controls** — keep specular and pores from going plastic  
- **Optional external MASK** — best quality when you already have a face/skin matte  
- **On-node before/after wipe** — same LC image-FX preview style  
- **Outputs** — graded `image` + `skin_mask` (inspect or reuse downstream)

---

## Features

| Control | What it does |
|--------|----------------|
| **preset** | Starting point (Natural, Light, Fresh, Porcelain, Warm keep, Custom). Loads slider values; then sliders are source of truth. |
| **strength** | How much of the effect to apply (0 = original, 1 = full, >1 = stronger). |
| **coolness** | Less yellow / cooler skin (LAB b*). |
| **brightness** | Overall skin lift (whitening), softened on highlights. |
| **rosy** | Pink/red flush (LAB a*). Negative = less red. |
| **evenness** | Local color evening under the mask. |
| **shadow_lift** | Extra lift in dark skin regions. |
| **smooth** | Mild softening under the mask. |
| **texture_preserve** | Caps how much smooth can flatten pores. |
| **saturation** | Skin chroma under the mask (negative = quieter). |
| **highlight_protect** | Reduce effect on bright specular skin. |
| **mask_sensitivity** | Auto mask inclusiveness. |
| **mask_feather** | Softness of mask edges. |
| **mask** (optional) | External skin matte; blended with auto for precision. |

---

## Getting the most out of it

| Goal | Suggested approach |
|------|---------------------|
| **Natural cleanup** | Preset **Natural**, strength **0.7–1.0**. Leave other sliders as loaded. |
| **Subtle only** | **Light**, strength **0.5–0.8**. |
| **Clearer / cooler** | **Fresh** or raise **coolness** slightly; keep **highlight_protect** high. |
| **Strong studio look** | **Porcelain**, strength **≤1.0**; raise **texture_preserve** if it goes plastic. |
| **Keep warmth** | **Warm keep**, or lower **coolness** and raise **rosy** a little. |
| **Less eye/lip change** | Already protected in auto mask; if needed, lower **strength** or use an external mask that excludes eyes/mouth. |
| **Prints still pick up** | Lower **mask_sensitivity**; inspect **skin_mask** output; or feed a real skin **MASK**. |
| **Hands / body too weak** | Raise **mask_sensitivity** slightly, or paint/segment those areas into **mask**. |
| **Plastic skin** | Lower **smooth**, raise **texture_preserve**, ease **evenness**. |
| **Flat highlights** | Raise **highlight_protect**; ease **brightness**. |
| **Quality check** | Preview **skin_mask** — white = affected, black = left alone. |

---

## Quick workflow

1. Image → **LC Skin Beauty ✨**  
2. Choose a **preset** (sliders update)  
3. Queue once; use the **wipe** to compare  
4. Adjust **strength** first, then one or two sliders  
5. Optional: view **skin_mask**; optional: wire an external **MASK**  

---

## Honest limits

Auto mask is **color + structure heuristics**, not a person segmenter. Ornate fabrics and warm bokeh can still leak a little. For critical work, pair with **SAM / face-parse / hand mask** on the **mask** input.

---

# 🗒️ LC Prompt Builder

Modular prompt tools for ComfyUI. Build a clean **text prompt** and optional **Krea2 / Ideogram-style JSON** without drawing boxes by hand.

> Wire each block → **Assembler** → use **prompt** for normal conditioning, **json** for regional builders.

---

## 🔗 Basic flow

```
Subject(s) ──┐
Scene ───────┤
Camera ──────┼──► 🗒️LC Prompt Assembler ──► prompt  → CLIP / conditioning
Lighting ────┤                           ──► json    → Krea2 / Ideogram builder
Style ───────┤
Color palette┘
```

Optional: **🎲LC Wildcard** into a subject description (or any STRING) for random lines from `assets/wildcards/`.

---

## 👤 Subjects

| Node | What it does |
|------|----------------|
| **🗒️LC Subject** | One person/character: description, pose, action, outfit, position (left/center/right, top/middle/bottom, foreground/mid/background). Live prompt at the bottom. |
| **🗒️LC Subject Array** | Merge several subjects into one string for the assembler (grows with connections). |

**Tips**
- Set **pose / action / outfit** to **none** when you type your own text or feed a wildcard.
- **Position** drives bbox placement in the JSON (thirds + depth). You can still move boxes on the Krea canvas later.
- Trailers like placement metadata are stripped from the readable **prompt**; they only feed the **json**.

---

## 🌆 Scene · 📷 Camera · 💡 Lighting · 🎨 Style

| Node | What it does |
|------|----------------|
| **🗒️LC Scene Builder** | Preset environments + time of day + weather + optional extra notes. Detailed preset text; clashes with time/weather are cleaned up in the live preview. |
| **🗒️LC Camera** | Angle, distance (shot size), depth of field, optional free prompt. |
| **🗒️LC Lighting** | Lighting style + direction, optional free prompt. |
| **🗒️LC Style Selector** | Category, preset, quality level → style line for the stack. |

**Tips**
- Prefer presets for consistency; use the free **prompt** fields for one-off details.
- Scene still contributes **background text** even when scene bboxes are off.

---

## 🎨 Color palette

| Node | What it does |
|------|----------------|
| **🎨LC Color Palette** | Preset swatches or sample colors **from an image**. Prompt text (hex list) + preview image. |

Image-node color (`#324B4B`). Use the **prompt** socket into the assembler **palette** input.

---

## 🎲 Wildcard

| Node | What it does |
|------|----------------|
| **🎲LC Wildcard** | Pick a list under `assets/wildcards/`, output one random line (seed-stable). |

- **base_seed** + **seed_mode**: fixed / randomize / increment / decrement (works on partial runs).
- No seed output — plug **text** into subject description, join strings, etc.
- Lists are plain `.txt` files (one entry per line). Edit anytime; restart once if the dropdown is stale.

---

## 🧩 Assembler (the hub)

**🧩LC Prompt Assembler**

| Output | Use for |
|--------|---------|
| **prompt** | Human-readable stack → **CLIP / conditioning** (no regional builder). |
| **json** | Krea2 Regional / Ideogram-style **import_json** (structured caption + subject bboxes). |

| Widget | Meaning |
|--------|---------|
| **pretty_print** | Indented JSON vs compact. |
| **remove_empty** | Drop blank sections. |
| **include_scene_bboxes** | **Off by default.** On = also emit furniture/landmark boxes from the scene. Off = **subject boxes only**. |
| **margin** | Inset all boxes from the frame edge (default **5%**). |

**Important**
- **Krea2 does not “read JSON” inside the model.** Builders parse JSON; the model still sees text + any regional conditioning those builders create.
- Plain path: **prompt → conditioning**.  
- Regional path: **json → builder →** that node’s outputs.


---

## ✅ Quick recipes

**1. Simple text-only (no regional)**

# 🗒️ LC Prompt Builder

Modular prompt tools for ComfyUI. Build a clean **text prompt** and optional **Krea2 / Ideogram-style JSON** without drawing boxes by hand.

```
Subject(s) ──┐
Scene ───────┤
Camera ──────┼──► 🗒️LC Prompt Assembler ──► prompt  → CLIP / conditioning
Lighting ────┤                           ──► json    → Krea2 / Ideogram builder
Style ───────┤
Color palette┘
```

| Node | What it does |
|------|----------------|
| **🗒️LC Subject** | One person/character: description, pose, action, outfit, position (left/center/right, top/middle/bottom, foreground/mid/background). Live prompt at the bottom. |
| **🗒️LC Subject Array** | Merge several subjects into one string for the assembler (grows with connections). |

- Set **pose / action / outfit** to **none** when you type your own text or feed a wildcard.

| **🗒️LC Lighting** | Lighting style + direction, optional free prompt. |

- Prefer presets for consistency; use the free **prompt** fields for one-off details.

- same as a standard basic scheduler, but without noise injection

## See My **LC Lighting Contol** workflow included in this node pack

### Light model

- **XYZ** = beam **aim** (direction). **Z is 0…1 only** (0 = side plane, **1 = front**).
- **light size** = **cone width**: small = narrow spot, large = flood.
- **intensity** = key strength · **ambient** = shadow floor (0 = pure key).
- **depth_scale** = far pixels fall off inside the beam (0 = no depth falloff).
- **cast_shadows** = screen-space occlusion from depth (localized; not a global grey wash).

Default launch (new node): ambient **0.25**, light1 **(0, 0.5, 0.9)**, intensity **1**, size **1**, cast shadows **on**, strength **0.5**.

### Light stage (widget under the params)

- **White** handle = light 1 · **Red** = light 2 (when enabled)
- Drag = **XY** aim
- **Shift+drag** vertical or **wheel** on handle = **Z** (depth / toward camera)

widgets_values:
# ComfyUI LC123 Nodes

Custom nodes for [ComfyUI](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI) by [lonecatone23](https://github.com/lonecatone23).

- **Repo:** [https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC123_nodes](https://github.com/lonecatone23/ComfyUI_LC123_nodes)
- **Support:** [Buy me a ☕](https://ko-fi.com/lonecatone)
- **Version:** 1.10.2

> Small tools that remove friction — less wire mess, fewer clicks, clearer workflows.

> **"True, nothing is. Permitted, everything is"**  
> — Yoda Auditore, *Assassin's Wars*

For **Anima regional attention**, also install [Sen-sou Anima Regional Conditioning](https://github.com/Sen-sou/Comfyui-Anima-Regional-Conditioning).

---


## ⚙️ LC123 Performance (Settings)

**UI only** — smoother scrolling and lighter on-node previews. Does **not** change generation VRAM or socket output quality.

**Settings → LC123 → Performance**

| Setting | Default | Effect |
|--------|---------|--------|
| **Remove wipe** | Off | No hover wipe on image FX previews |
| **Half-resolution previews** | Off | FX previews at half the node image area |
| **Clamp longest side** | Off | Cap on-node preview bitmap size |
| **Max edge (px)** | 768 | Used when clamp is on |
| **No preview when collapsed** | On | Skip draw on collapsed FX nodes |
| **Hide FX on-node previews** | Off | Hide all LC image FX on-node previews |
| **Skin Beauty full preview override** | On | Skin Beauty stays full quality on-node |

**Not affected:** LC Image Compare · LC Dynamic Overlay · LC Image Split  

Full directions: [`LC123_Performance_Settings_Note.md`](LC123_Performance_Settings_Note.md)

---

## ✨ LC Skin Beauty

Mask-aware skin cooling and brightening in **CIELAB**. Grades **skin**, not the whole frame. Presets + full slider control; optional external mask.

---

## 📷 LC Photo Style

Camera / phone **finish** look (not lens geometry). Style presets drive the sliders; most controls use **0 = no change**. **Strength** blends with the original.

Presets include Standard, Natural, Dramatic, Quiet, Muted, Amateur, Cool day, Warm evening, Bright open, iPhone, **Nikon Z7 II**, **Canon R5**.

Full control list: [`LC_Photo_Style_Note.md`](LC_Photo_Style_Note.md)

---

## 🔪 LC Sharpen Pro — quick use

- **Default path (realism / influencers / NSFW):** start on **Natural** or **Portrait**. Raise **clarity** before **sharpen**. Keep **halo** and **skin_protect** up on faces.
- **Crisp:** photo snap, not ink outlines (higher halo, moderate sharpen).
- **Lineart / Anime sharp:** deliberate edge punch for art workflows — lower skin/halo on purpose.
- Moving any slider after a preset → **Custom**.
- **strength** at 1.0 = full effect; use a bypasser if you want a hard off switch.

---

## 🖼️ Image & size

| Node | What it does |
|------|----------------|
| **📐 Aspect Ratio Simplifier** | Size from image, mask, or preset. Resize image + mask together. Crop / stretch / pad / total pixels. Empty latent out. Default upscale: **lanczos**. `resolution` = longer side. |
| **LC Aspect Ratio Simplifier 📐(Pipe)** | Same controls, plus a **pipe** output on top for Get/Set routing. |
| **LC Aspect Ratio Pipe Out** | Unpacks an aspect-ratio pipe into image, mask, width, height, latent, batch, resolution. |
| **LC Get Image 📐** | Reads an image; shows megapixels, width, height, batch, aspect ratio, and resolution (longer side). |
| **LC Dimension Resize 📐** | Width + height + one value; add / subtract / multiply / divide both sides; rounded width & height out. |
| **LC Image Crop 🖼️🔪** | Interactive crop with aspect lock; preview on the node; cropped image out. |
| **LC Image Compare 🔎** | Batch A/B compare with one slider (A1↔B1, A2↔B2, …). Layout stays fixed. |
| **LC Image Split 🖼️** | Saveable wipe: **slider only** sets the split; position sticks until you change it. Output = split image. |
| **LC Image Grid 🖼️** | Multi-image contact sheet (max columns, gap, cell pad, outline/border colors). |
| **LC Last Image Holder** | Holds the last image for before/after. Survives disconnect; clear empties without re-running. Modes: hold last generation / hold until cleared. |
| **LC Dynamic Overlay** | Overlay B on A (A sets resolution). After one queue, drag the opacity knob — no re-gen to preview. Output: **blended Image**. |
| **LC Watermark 💧** | Image watermark: size, opacity, drag place. Bypasses if no watermark image. |

---

## 🎨 Image FX (on-node preview + before/after wipe)

Most show the result on the node. Hover to wipe against the original  
(see **LC123 Performance** to lighten UI load).

| Node | What it does |
|------|----------------|
| **LC Image Adjust** | Brightness, contrast, saturation, hue, etc. (−1…1 style controls). |
| **LC Auto White Balance** | Auto white-balance correction. |
| **LC Sharpen Pro** | **Photorealism-first** clarity + edge sharpen. Guided + box hybrid high-pass; auto halo; skin protect. Presets: Natural, Subtle, Portrait, Product, Landscape, Crisp, **Lineart**, **Anime sharp**. |
| **LC Lens Effects** | Lens-style FX suite. |
| **LC Lens Profile** | Lens profile / correction style FX. |
| **LC Lift Gamma Gain** | Lift / gamma / gain color-wheel style adjust. |
| **LC Image RGB** | Per-channel RGB adjust. |
| **LC Film Grain** | Film grain overlay. |
| **LC Film Stock (B&W)** | B&W film stock look. |
| **LC Film Stock (Color)** | Color film stock look. |
| **LC Vibrance** | Vibrance (smart saturation). |
| **LC Vignette** | Vignette darkening. |
| **LC Bloom** | Soft bloom / glow. |
| **LC Chromatic Aberration** | RGB fringe / CA control. |
| **LC Image Denoise** | Detail-preserving denoise. |
| **LC Color Match 🎨** | Match colors to a reference; strength; skin-protect aware. |
| **LC Image Desaturate** | Desaturate (Essentials-style). |
| **LC Skin Beauty ✨** | Skin-focused beauty pass (see above). |
| **LC Photo Style 📷** | Camera / phone finish (see above). |
| **LC Apply LUT** | Apply a LUT from **`ComfyUI/models/luts/`**. Pack may seed samples into that folder on load without overwriting. Ship extras under `assets/luts/` as assets only. |
| **LC Text Overlay** | Text on image; font size/color; **alignment** left/center/right (bottom default); drag + widgets. |

---

## 🧬 Sampling, sigma & pipes

| Node | What it does |
|------|----------------|
| **LC Sampler Configure** | total steps, step swap, detailer steps, denoise (0.01 steps), CFG1/2, sampler, scheduler. |
| **LC Sampler Configure (pipe)** | Same, pipe-oriented layout. |
| **LC Sampler Configure Pipe Out** | Unpacks sampler configure pipe. |
| **LC Pipe (in/edit)** | Pack/edit full LC pipe (models, clips, VAEs, size, latent, prompts, conds, seed, steps, CFGs, sampler…). |
| **LC Pipe Out** | Unpack full LC pipe. |
| **LC Detail Pipe Out** | Detailer-oriented unpack (model/clip/vae, prompts, conds, seed, cfg, sampler, scheduler, detailer steps). |
| **LC Split Sigma Scheduler** | Split one schedule across two models at step swap. |
| **LC Split Sigmas (Advanced)** | Two sigma curves in (sigma 1 / sigma 2); model 1 / model 2; step swap + denoise; sigmas high/low out. Missing model/sigma 2 falls back to 1. |
| **LC Basic Scheduler** | Scheduler + steps → sigmas (no denoise). |
| **Prompt to Conditioning** | String → conditioning. |
| **LC Prompt to Conditioning + Zero** | Encode + zero-out style second socket. |
| **Positive / Negative** | Prompt boxes (green / red). |

---

## 📁 Save paths & text

| Node | What it does |
|------|----------------|
| **LC Easy Folder 📂** | Builds `filename_prefix` for native Save Image (`Folder\prefix_suffix_timestamp`). |
| **LC Advanced Folder 📂** | Split filename + path (Image Saver Simple style). |
| **📝 LC Save Text** | Write text to a file; **sanitizes** illegal path characters. |
| **LC Join Strings 🔗** | Join N strings with a delimiter; empty/null slots skip the delimiter; `\n` allowed. |
| **LC Show Text 🔤** | Display text on the node (list-friendly). |
| **LC Text Replace ✂️** | Up to 20 find/replace pairs; grows/shrinks with entry count. |
| **LC Text Remove 🔪** | Same layout as replace, remove-only. |
| **Civitai 🚩🔪** | Compliance strip from `assets/lists/civitai_compliance_remove.txt`. **Your** responsibility to meet Civitai TOS; list is not guaranteed complete. |

---

## 🔀 Switches, logic & control

| Node | What it does |
|------|----------------|
| **LC AnySwitch** | First connected input among many; type-locks from first wire; 2–20 inputs. |
| **LC Combo Selector** | Dropdown that mirrors another node’s combo options. |
| **LC Boolean** | Coerce boolean / int / float → true/false; shows result on the face. |
| **LC Invert Boolean** | Same coercion, then invert. |
| **LC Int Compare** | Two INT inputs → largest or smallest. |
| **LC Float Compare** | Two FLOAT inputs → largest or smallest. |
| **LC Seed Jump 🌱** | One seed + jump size → six stepped seed outputs. |
| **LC Slider** | On-node slider; min/max/step/decimals in settings. INT or FLOAT. |
| **LC Node Snapshot 📋** | Wire a **source** node (or type id/title); pick a **widget**; outputs selected value, full newline string, and JSON (includes node id). Multiple snapshots can target the same node. |
| **LC Notify 🔊** | Play a sound from `assets/sounds/` on run; ▶ preview on the node. |
| **LC Bypasser** | Bypass linked nodes; toggle restriction: default / max one / always one. |
| **LC Groups Bypasser** | Same for graph groups. |
| **LC Bypasser Panel** | Widgets-only remote for a bypasser hub. |
| **LC Stop 🛑** | Pause until button (with enable/bypass). |
| **LC VRAM Cache Clear** | Clear VRAM / cache; any-in / any-out pass-through. |

---

## 🎨 Regional canvas

| Node | What it does |
|------|----------------|
| **Anima Regional Inline Canvas** | RGB paint canvas for Sen-sou Anima regional conditioning. |
| **Krea2 Regional Inline Canvas** | Same idea for Krea2 CLIP regions (**beta**). |

---

## 📦 Assets

| Path | Use |
|------|-----|
| `assets/sounds/` | Notification sounds for **LC Notify 🔊** |
| `assets/lists/` | Text lists (e.g. Civitai compliance strip) |
| `assets/luts/` | Sample LUTs shipped with the pack (copied to **`models/luts/`** on load if missing — never overwrites) |
| `assets/readme/` | Images used in this README (optional) |

**LUT path for Apply LUT:** `ComfyUI/models/luts/` (not under custom_nodes).

---

## 💡 Quick tips

- **Image FX:** fix seed, run low-res, tune, then full run.
- **Sharpen Pro:** realism users live on Natural/Portrait; art users use Lineart/Anime sharp.
- **Bypasser:** wire hubs; optional Panel so the hub can stay collapsed.
- **Save Text / folders:** avoid `? < > : " | *` in names — Save Text sanitizes; folders still prefer clean names.
- **Pipes + Get/Set:** if a graph “always regenerates,” try a direct pipe link to confirm caching.
- **Dual sigma:** encode prompts to CONDITIONING before CFGGuider — empty conds fail.
- **Notify:** drop `.mp3` / `.wav` into `assets/sounds/`, restart once so the dropdown refreshes.
- **Snapshot:** optional `source` input preferred; target id/title still works when linked resolution succeeds.

---

_Yoda Auditore. *Assassin's Wars*_

| **Hide FX on-node previews** | Off | Hide all LC image FX on-node previews |
| **Skin Beauty full preview override** | On | Skin Beauty stays full quality on-node |

**Not affected:** LC Image Compare · LC Dynamic Overlay · LC Image Split  

Full directions: [`LC123_Performance_Settings_Note.md`](LC123_Performance_Settings_Note.md)

---

## ✨ LC Skin Beauty

Mask-aware skin cooling and brightening in **CIELAB**. Grades **skin**, not the whole frame. Presets + full slider control; optional external mask.

---

## 📷 LC Photo Style

Camera / phone **finish** look (not lens geometry). Style presets drive the sliders; most controls use **0 = no change**. **Strength** blends with the original.

Presets include Standard, Natural, Dramatic, Quiet, Muted, Amateur, Cool day, Warm evening, Bright open, iPhone, **Nikon Z7 II**, **Canon R5**.

Full control list: [`LC_Photo_Style_Note.md`](LC_Photo_Style_Note.md)

---

## 🔪 LC Sharpen Pro — quick use

- **Default path (realism / influencers / NSFW):** start on **Natural** or **Portrait**. Raise **clarity** before **sharpen**. Keep **halo** and **skin_protect** up on faces.
- **Crisp:** photo snap, not ink outlines (higher halo, moderate sharpen).
- **Lineart / Anime sharp:** deliberate edge punch for art workflows — lower skin/halo on purpose.
- Moving any slider after a preset → **Custom**.
- **strength** at 1.0 = full effect; use a bypasser if you want a hard off switch.

---

## 🖼️ Image & size

|------|----------------|

| **LC Aspect Ratio Pipe Out** | Unpacks an aspect-ratio pipe into image, mask, width, height, latent, batch, resolution. |
| **LC Get Image 📐** | Reads an image; shows megapixels, width, height, batch, aspect ratio, and resolution (longer side). |
| **LC Dimension Resize 📐** | Width + height + one value; add / subtract / multiply / divide both sides; rounded width & height out. |
| **LC Image Crop 🖼️🔪** | Interactive crop with aspect lock; preview on the node; cropped image out. |
| **LC Image Compare 🔎** | Batch A/B compare with one slider (A1↔B1, A2↔B2, …). Layout stays fixed. |
| **LC Image Split 🖼️** | Saveable wipe: **slider only** sets the split; position sticks until you change it. Output = split image. |
| **LC Image Grid 🖼️** | Multi-image contact sheet (max columns, gap, cell pad, outline/border colors). |
| **LC Last Image Holder** | Holds the last image for before/after. Survives disconnect; clear empties without re-running. Modes: hold last generation / hold until cleared. |
| **LC Dynamic Overlay** | Overlay B on A (A sets resolution). After one queue, drag the opacity knob — no re-gen to preview. Output: **blended Image**. |
| **LC Watermark 💧** | Image watermark: size, opacity, drag place. Bypasses if no watermark image. |

Most show the result on the node. Hover to wipe against the original  
(see **LC123 Performance** to lighten UI load).

|------|----------------|
| **LC Image Adjust** | Brightness, contrast, saturation, hue, etc. (−1…1 style controls). |
| **LC Auto White Balance** | Auto white-balance correction. |
| **LC Sharpen Pro** | **Photorealism-first** clarity + edge sharpen. Guided + box hybrid high-pass; auto halo; skin protect. Presets: Natural, Subtle, Portrait, Product, Landscape, Crisp, **Lineart**, **Anime sharp**. |
| **LC Lens Effects** | Lens-style FX suite. |
| **LC Lens Profile** | Lens profile / correction style FX. |
| **LC Lift Gamma Gain** | Lift / gamma / gain color-wheel style adjust. |
| **LC Image RGB** | Per-channel RGB adjust. |
| **LC Film Grain** | Film grain overlay. |
| **LC Film Stock (B&W)** | B&W film stock look. |
| **LC Film Stock (Color)** | Color film stock look. |
| **LC Vibrance** | Vibrance (smart saturation). |
| **LC Vignette** | Vignette darkening. |
| **LC Bloom** | Soft bloom / glow. |
| **LC Chromatic Aberration** | RGB fringe / CA control. |
| **LC Image Denoise** | Detail-preserving denoise. |

|------|----------------|

---

| Node | What it does |
|------|----------------|
| **LC Easy Folder 📂** | Builds `filename_prefix` for native Save Image (`Folder\prefix_suffix_timestamp`). |
| **LC Advanced Folder 📂** | Split filename + path (Image Saver Simple style). |

| **LC Join Strings 🔗** | Join N strings with a delimiter; empty/null slots skip the delimiter; `\n` allowed. |
| **LC Show Text 🔤** | Display text on the node (list-friendly). |

| Node | What it does |
|------|----------------|
| **LC AnySwitch** | First connected input among many; type-locks from first wire; 2–20 inputs. |
| **LC Combo Selector** | Dropdown that mirrors another node’s combo options. |
| **LC Boolean** | Coerce boolean / int / float → true/false; shows result on the face. |
| **LC Invert Boolean** | Same coercion, then invert. |
| **LC Int Compare** | Two INT inputs → largest or smallest. |
| **LC Float Compare** | Two FLOAT inputs → largest or smallest. |
| **LC Seed Jump 🌱** | One seed + jump size → six stepped seed outputs. |
| **LC Slider** | On-node slider; min/max/step/decimals in settings. INT or FLOAT. |
| **LC Node Snapshot 📋** | Wire a **source** node (or type id/title); pick a **widget**; outputs selected value, full newline string, and JSON (includes node id). Multiple snapshots can target the same node. |
| **LC Notify 🔊** | Play a sound from `assets/sounds/` on run; ▶ preview on the node. |
| **LC Bypasser** | Bypass linked nodes; toggle restriction: default / max one / always one. |
| **LC Groups Bypasser** | Same for graph groups. |
| **LC Bypasser Panel** | Widgets-only remote for a bypasser hub. |
| **LC Stop 🛑** | Pause until button (with enable/bypass). |
| **LC VRAM Cache Clear** | Clear VRAM / cache; any-in / any-out pass-through. |

---

## 🎨 Regional canvas

| Node | What it does |
|------|----------------|
| **Anima Regional Inline Canvas** | RGB paint canvas for Sen-sou Anima regional conditioning. |
| **Krea2 Regional Inline Canvas** | Same idea for Krea2 CLIP regions (**beta**). |

---

## 📦 Assets

| Path | Use |
|------|-----|
| `assets/sounds/` | Notification sounds for **LC Notify 🔊** |
| `assets/lists/` | Text lists (e.g. Civitai compliance strip) |
| `assets/luts/` | Sample LUTs shipped with the pack (copied to **`models/luts/`** on load if missing — never overwrites) |
| `assets/readme/` | Images used in this README (optional) |

**LUT path for Apply LUT:** `ComfyUI/models/luts/` (not under custom_nodes).

---

## 💡 Quick tips

- **Image FX:** fix seed, run low-res, tune, then full run.
- **Sharpen Pro:** realism users live on Natural/Portrait; art users use Lineart/Anime sharp.
- **Bypasser:** wire hubs; optional Panel so the hub can stay collapsed.
- **Save Text / folders:** avoid `? < > : " | *` in names — Save Text sanitizes; folders still prefer clean names.
- **Pipes + Get/Set:** if a graph “always regenerates,” try a direct pipe link to confirm caching.
- **Dual sigma:** encode prompts to CONDITIONING before CFGGuider — empty conds fail.
- **Notify:** drop `.mp3` / `.wav` into `assets/sounds/`, restart once so the dropdown refreshes.
- **Snapshot:** optional `source` input preferred; target id/title still works when linked resolution succeeds.

---

**"True, nothing is. Permitted, everything is"**  
_Yoda Auditore. *Assassin's Wars*_

widgets_values:
# LC123 Performance Settings ⚙️

> **UI only** — smoother scrolling and lighter on-node previews.  
> These settings do **not** change generation VRAM, model load, or output image quality on the sockets.

---

## Where to find them

1. Open **ComfyUI Settings** (gear).
2. In the sidebar, open **LC123**.
3. Open **Performance**.

If you don’t see the full list: restart ComfyUI, then **Ctrl+F5** (hard refresh) so the updated `web/lc_performance_settings.js` loads.

---

## What each option does

| Setting | Default | What it does |
|--------|---------|----------------|
| **Remove wipe** | Off | Turns off hover A/B wipe on **image FX** nodes. Last result still shows. |
| **Half-resolution previews** | Off | Draws FX previews at **half** the node’s image area (less GPU/CPU work while panning). |
| **Clamp longest side** | Off | Downscales the **on-node** preview bitmap so the longest side ≤ **Max edge**. |
| **Max edge (px)** | 768 | Used only when **Clamp longest side** is on. Try 512–1024 on heavy graphs. |
| **No preview when collapsed** | On | Collapsed FX nodes skip drawing previews (less work while scrolling). |
| **Hide FX on-node previews** | Off | Hides all LC **image FX** on-node previews. Socket outputs are unchanged. |
| **Skin Beauty full preview override** | On | **LC Skin Beauty** keeps a **full-quality** on-node preview even if half-res / clamp are on (for zooming skin detail). Wipe still follows **Remove wipe**. |

---

## What is *not* affected

These stay fully interactive and are **not** driven by the Performance toggles:

- **LC Image Compare 🔎**
- **LC Dynamic Overlay**
- **LC Image Split 🖼️**

Generation, Save Image, and every **IMAGE** output socket still use full resolution.

---

## Suggested setups

### Default (shipped)
Leave everything at default: full FX previews, wipe on, Skin Beauty override on.

### Heavy graph / laggy scroll
1. Turn **Half-resolution previews** **On**  
2. Turn **Clamp longest side** **On** (Max edge **512** or **768**)  
3. Keep **No preview when collapsed** **On**  
4. Leave **Skin Beauty full preview override** **On** if you still inspect skin on the node  

### Maximum UI lightness
1. **Hide FX on-node previews** **On**  
2. Or use **Remove wipe** + half-res + clamp  
3. Use **Image Compare** / **Image Split** when you need a wipe  

---

## Notes

- Changes apply on the next canvas redraw (panning or queue is enough; no reinstall needed).
- Optional SAM / LayerStyle / big models are separate from these settings; they still use their own VRAM.
- Pack files: `web/lc_performance_settings.js`, `web/lc_image_preview.js`

nodes.title: LC Photo Style 📷
widgets_values:
# LC Photo Style 📷

Standalone **camera / phone finish** look. Pick a **style**, then tweak the sliders.  
Most controls use **0 = no change**. **Strength** blends with the original image.

Not a lens tool — color, tone, texture, vignette, and grain only.

---

## Widgets

| Widget | What it does |
|--------|----------------|
| **style** | Starting preset (fills the sliders). Customize freely after. |
| **strength** | 0 = original image · 1 = full processed look. |
| **seed** | Grain seed only (same seed = same grain pattern). |
| **wb_temperature** | 0 = no change. − cooler · + warmer. |
| **wb_tint** | 0 = no change. − green · + magenta. |
| **exposure** | 0 = no change. Overall brightness (EV-style). |
| **contrast** | 0 = no change. + punches midtones · − flattens. |
| **shadows** | 0 = off. Lifts **dark areas only** (no white haze). |
| **highlights** | 0 = off. Softly compresses bright areas. |
| **hdr_local** | 0 = off. Mild local tone (opens shadows a bit / softens local contrast). |
| **vibrance** | 0 = no change. + boosts muted colors · − pulls them down. |
| **skin_protect** | Limits vibrance on skin hues (only matters when vibrance ≠ 0). |
| **shadow_cool** | 0 = off. Cool (blue) tint in mid-shadows — skips pure black. |
| **highlight_warm** | 0 = off. Warm tint in highlights. |
| **texture** | 0 = no change. Fine detail · − softens. |
| **clarity** | 0 = no change. Mid-scale local contrast · − softens. |
| **vignette** | 0 = off. Darkens the corners. |
| **grain** | 0 = off. Neutral mono grain (stronger in shadows). |

---

## Styles (presets)

| Style | Intent |
|-------|--------|
| **Standard** | Balanced default |
| **Natural** | Soft / restrained |
| **Dramatic** | Darker, more contrast and vignette |
| **Quiet** | Cool, low-key |
| **Muted** | Flatter / less saturation |
| **Amateur** | Uneven WB, stronger grain and vignette |
| **Cool day** | Cool / cyan lean |
| **Warm evening** | Amber / warm lean |
| **Bright open** | High exposure, lifted shadows and highlights |
| **iPhone** | Modern phone-style: shadow lift, soft highlights, skin-safe color |
| **Nikon Z7 II** | Neutral-cool, firmer mid contrast, clean texture |
| **Canon R5** | Mild warm, skin-friendly, soft highlight roll-off |

---

## Quick tips

- Start with a **style**, set **strength** ~0.7–0.9, then nudge one or two sliders.
- All zeros + strength anything → image unchanged.
- **Shadows** opens blacks; it does **not** add a white fog.
- For a softer result without changing the preset, lower **strength** first.
- Pair with **LC Image Split** or **LC Image Compare** if you want a fixed before/after.

---

**"True, nothing is. Permitted, everything is"**  
_Yoda Auditore · Assassin's Wars_

nodes.title: Notes:
widgets_values:
## Instructions

# 🛑🚫✋ I HIGHLY suggest that you fix the seed, run the pic, then don’t mess with anything before this so it doesn’t reprocess.

### Node order (follow the chain top → bottom)

**Smart Denoise (LCImageDenoise)**  
- Removes noise while trying to keep detail  
- Sigma: higher = smoother, lower = more detail  
- Threshold: how aggressive the denoise is  
- Radius Multiplier: higher for noisy images, lower for clean ones  
💡 Start gentle. Only raise values if the image is actually noisy.

**Color Match (LCColorMatch)**  
- Matches colors to a reference image (usually Image 2)  
- Method: “adain” is the most common and stable  
- Strength: 0–1  
- hook up a mask 🎭 to isolate it (similar to LC Tone match below)

**Bloom (LCBloom)**  
- Soft glow on bright areas (camera light bloom)  
- Intensity, threshold, and size controls  
💡 A little makes it dreamy. A lot makes it foggy.

**Vignette (LCVignette)**  
- Darkens (or lightens) the edges  
- Amount, softness, and roundness  
💡 Soft vignette looks more natural than hard black borders.

**Image RGB (LCImageRGB)**  
- Simple red / green / blue channel gain  

**Lift / Gamma / Gain (LCLiftGammaGain)**  
- Classic three-way color corrector  
- Lift = shadows  
- Gamma = midtones  
- Gain = highlights  
💡 This is where most “film look” color work happens.

**Auto White Balance (LCAutoWhiteBalance)**  
- Tries to neutralize overall color cast  
- Method: “Shades of Gray” is usually safest  
💡 Effect is subtle — compare before/after.

**Vibrance (LCVibrance)**  
- Boosts muted colors without destroying already-saturated areas  
- Kinder to skin than normal saturation  
- Vibrance + Saturation + Strength  
💡 Prefer this over regular saturation for portraits.

**Chromatic Aberration (LCChromaticAberration)**  
- Shifts RGB channels for a 3-D / vintage lens look  
- Separate horizontal/vertical amounts for R, G, B  
💡 A little goes a long way. Try small opposite values (R +2, G –1, B –3).

**Sharpen Pro (LCSharpenPro)**  
- Adaptive mid-tone contrast / micro-contrast  
- Radius, strength, blend mode, shadow/highlight controls  
💡 Super important node. Adds “pop” without the cardboard cut-out look.

**Image Adjust (LCImageAdjust)**  
- Brightness, Contrast, Saturation, Sharpness, Blur  
- Brightness center = 0  
- Contrast & Saturation center = 1  

**Lens FX (LCLensFX)**  
- General lens distortion and optical effects  
💡 Pair with the next node for more realistic camera simulation.

**Lens Profile (LCLensProfile)**  
- Applies real lens characteristics (e.g. Canon 50mm f/1.8)  
- Optional aberrations  
💡 Adds subtle optical imperfections that make AI images feel more photographic.

**Film Stock B&W (LCFilmStockBW)**  
- Converts to black & white using real film responses  
- 50+ stocks (Ilford HP5+, Kodak Tri-X, Fuji Acros, etc.)  
- Strength + optional filter  
💡 Leave this off if you want to keep color.

**Film Stock Color (LCFilmStockColor)**  
- Applies classic color film response (Ektachrome, Portra, etc.)  
- Strength is the main control  
💡 0.6–0.9 often looks more natural than full strength.

**Film Grain (LCFilmGrain)**  
- Realistic film grain with lots of control  
- Power, scale, shadows/highlights, seed  
💡 Fixed seed keeps the grain consistent. Slightly more grain in shadows usually looks better.

**Desaturate (LCImageDesaturate)**  
- Partial or full desaturation  
- Several methods (luminance Rec.709 is common)  
💡 Useful right before a LUT if you want a muted base.

**Apply LUT (LCApplyLUT)**  
- Applies a 3D LUT (.cube file)  
- Strength 0–1  
- Log option for certain LUTs  
💡 Free LUTs at freshluts.com. Strength 0.3–0.7 is often nicer than 1.0. Put .cube files in the luts folder.

**Image Crop (LCImageCrop)**  
- Inline crop tool  
- X / Y / Width / Height or free mode  
💡 Crop after all effects so you don’t lose edge treatments (vignette, bloom, etc.).

**Text Overlay (LCTextOverlay)**  
- Adds text on the final image  
- Font, size, color, position, opacity  
- applies on 2nd run   

**LC Watermark 💧(LCWatermark)**
- dynamically adds any image as a watermark
- adjust size, location, and opacity
- applies on the 2nd run

## 使用说明

# 🛑🚫✋ 强烈建议你先固定 seed，跑完图片，然后不要再动之前的任何设置，以免重新处理。

### 节点顺序（按链条从上到下）

**智能降噪 (LCImageDenoise)**  
- 在尽量保留细节的同时去除噪点  
- Sigma：数值高更平滑，低则保留更多细节  
- Threshold：控制降噪强度  
- Radius Multiplier：噪点多的图用高值，干净的图用低值  
💡 从低数值开始。只有真正很噪的时候才提高。

**颜色匹配 (LCColorMatch)**  
- 让当前图匹配参考图（通常是 Image 2）的色调  
- 方法：adain 最常用也最稳定  
- 强度：0–1  
💡 做系列图统一肤色或情绪时很好用。不需要时把参考关掉。

**光晕 (LCBloom)**  
- 给高光加柔和辉光，模拟相机过曝  
- 强度、阈值、大小  
💡 少用一点很梦幻，多用就变雾了。

**暗角 (LCVignette)**  
- 压暗（或提亮）边缘  
- 强度、柔和度、圆度  
💡 柔和暗角比硬黑边自然得多。

**RGB 调整 (LCImageRGB)**  
- 简单的红 / 绿 / 蓝通道增益  


**Lift / Gamma / Gain (LCLiftGammaGain)**  
- 经典三点校色  
- Lift = 阴影  
- Gamma = 中间调  
- Gain = 高光  
💡 大部分“胶片感”颜色工作都在这里完成。

**自动白平衡 (LCAutoWhiteBalance)**  
- 尝试中和整体色偏  
- 方法：“Shades of Gray” 通常最稳妥  
💡 效果比较细微，记得对比前后。

**自然饱和度 (LCVibrance)**  
- 提升不饱和颜色，对已经很艳的颜色和肤色更友好  
- 自然饱和度 + 饱和度 + 强度  
💡 人像优先用这个，而不是普通饱和度。

**色差 (LCChromaticAberration)**  
- 错开 RGB 通道，做出 3D / 复古镜头感  
- 可分别调整红、绿、蓝的水平和垂直偏移  
💡 一点就够。可以试小相反数值（R +2，G –1，B –3）。

**锐化专业版（LCSharpenPro）**

- 自适应中调对比度 / 微对比度  
- 半径、强度、混合模式，以及阴影/高光控制  
💡 非常重要的节点。能增加“层次感/通透感”，又不会做出纸片人那种假锐化。

**图像调整 (LCImageAdjust)**  
- 亮度、对比度、饱和度、锐度、模糊  
- 亮度中心 = 0  
- 对比度与饱和度中心 = 1  


**镜头特效 (LCLensFX)**  
- 通用镜头畸变和光学效果  
💡 和下一个节点一起用，模拟更真实的相机光学。

**镜头配置文件 (LCLensProfile)**  
- 应用真实镜头特性（例如 Canon 50mm f/1.8）  
- 可选色差  
💡 给 AI 图加一点真实光学瑕疵，照片感会强很多。

**黑白胶片 (LCFilmStockBW)**  
- 用真实胶片光谱响应转黑白  
- 50+ 种胶片（Ilford HP5+、Kodak Tri-X、Fuji Acros 等）  
- 强度 + 可选滤镜  
💡 想留彩色就关掉这个。

**彩色胶片 (LCFilmStockColor)**  
- 应用经典彩色胶片响应（Ektachrome、Portra 等）  
- 强度是主要控制  
💡 0.6–0.9 往往比满强度更自然。

**胶片颗粒 (LCFilmGrain)**  
- 可精细控制的真实胶片颗粒  
- 强度、缩放、阴影/高光、种子  
💡 固定种子可以让颗粒保持一致。阴影区域颗粒稍强通常更好看。

**去饱和 (LCImageDesaturate)**  
- 部分或完全去饱和  
- 多种方法可选（luminance Rec.709 较常用）  
💡 在套 LUT 之前用，可以做出更柔和的基础色。

**应用 LUT (LCApplyLUT)**  
- 套用 3D LUT（.cube 文件）  
- 强度 0–1  
- Log 选项（部分 LUT 需要）  
💡 免费 LUT 可在 freshluts.com 获取。强度 0.3–0.7 通常比 1.0 好看。把 .cube 文件放进 luts 文件夹。

**裁剪 (LCImageCrop)**  
- 内联裁剪工具  
- X / Y / 宽 / 高 或 free 模式  
💡 所有效果做完再裁，才不会丢掉边缘处理（暗角、光晕等）。

**文字叠加 (LCTextOverlay)**  
- 在最终图上加文字  
- 字体、大小、颜色、位置、透明度  


**LC 水印 💧（LCWatermark）**

* 可动态将任意图片添加为水印  
* 可调节大小、位置和透明度  
* 第 2 次运行时应用效果

## Instructions

# 🛑🚫✋ I HIGHLY suggest that you fix the seed, run the pic, then don’t mess with anything before this so it doesn’t reprocess.

### Node order (follow the chain top → bottom)

**Smart Denoise (LCImageDenoise)**  
- Removes noise while trying to keep detail  
- Sigma: higher = smoother, lower = more detail  
- Threshold: how aggressive the denoise is  
- Radius Multiplier: higher for noisy images, lower for clean ones  
💡 Start gentle. Only raise values if the image is actually noisy.

**Color Match (LCColorMatch)**  
- Matches colors to a reference image (usually Image 2)  
- Method: “adain” is the most common and stable  
- Strength: 0–1  
- hook up a mask 🎭 to isolate it (similar to LC Tone match below)

**Bloom (LCBloom)**  
- Soft glow on bright areas (camera light bloom)  
- Intensity, threshold, and size controls  
💡 A little makes it dreamy. A lot makes it foggy.

**Vignette (LCVignette)**  
- Darkens (or lightens) the edges  
- Amount, softness, and roundness  
💡 Soft vignette looks more natural than hard black borders.

**Image RGB (LCImageRGB)**  
- Simple red / green / blue channel gain  

**Lift / Gamma / Gain (LCLiftGammaGain)**  
- Classic three-way color corrector  
- Lift = shadows  
- Gamma = midtones  
- Gain = highlights  
💡 This is where most “film look” color work happens.

**Auto White Balance (LCAutoWhiteBalance)**  
- Tries to neutralize overall color cast  
- Method: “Shades of Gray” is usually safest  
💡 Effect is subtle — compare before/after.

**Vibrance (LCVibrance)**  
- Boosts muted colors without destroying already-saturated areas  
- Kinder to skin than normal saturation  
- Vibrance + Saturation + Strength  
💡 Prefer this over regular saturation for portraits.

**Chromatic Aberration (LCChromaticAberration)**  
- Shifts RGB channels for a 3-D / vintage lens look  
- Separate horizontal/vertical amounts for R, G, B  
💡 A little goes a long way. Try small opposite values (R +2, G –1, B –3).

**Sharpen Pro (LCSharpenPro)**  
- Adaptive mid-tone contrast / micro-contrast  
- Radius, strength, blend mode, shadow/highlight controls  
💡 Super important node. Adds “pop” without the cardboard cut-out look.

**Image Adjust (LCImageAdjust)**  
- Brightness, Contrast, Saturation, Sharpness, Blur  
- Brightness center = 0  
- Contrast & Saturation center = 1  

**Lens FX (LCLensFX)**  
- General lens distortion and optical effects  
💡 Pair with the next node for more realistic camera simulation.

**Lens Profile (LCLensProfile)**  
- Applies real lens characteristics (e.g. Canon 50mm f/1.8)  
- Optional aberrations  
💡 Adds subtle optical imperfections that make AI images feel more photographic.

**Film Stock B&W (LCFilmStockBW)**  
- Converts to black & white using real film responses  
- 50+ stocks (Ilford HP5+, Kodak Tri-X, Fuji Acros, etc.)  
- Strength + optional filter  
💡 Leave this off if you want to keep color.

**Film Stock Color (LCFilmStockColor)**  
- Applies classic color film response (Ektachrome, Portra, etc.)  
- Strength is the main control  
💡 0.6–0.9 often looks more natural than full strength.

**Film Grain (LCFilmGrain)**  
- Realistic film grain with lots of control  
- Power, scale, shadows/highlights, seed  
💡 Fixed seed keeps the grain consistent. Slightly more grain in shadows usually looks better.

**Desaturate (LCImageDesaturate)**  
- Partial or full desaturation  
- Several methods (luminance Rec.709 is common)  
💡 Useful right before a LUT if you want a muted base.

**Apply LUT (LCApplyLUT)**  
- Applies a 3D LUT (.cube file)  
- Strength 0–1  
- Log option for certain LUTs  
💡 Free LUTs at freshluts.com. Strength 0.3–0.7 is often nicer than 1.0. Put .cube files in the luts folder.

**Image Crop (LCImageCrop)**  
- Inline crop tool  
- X / Y / Width / Height or free mode  
💡 Crop after all effects so you don’t lose edge treatments (vignette, bloom, etc.).

**Text Overlay (LCTextOverlay)**  
- Adds text on the final image  
- Font, size, color, position, opacity  
- applies on 2nd run   

**LC Watermark 💧(LCWatermark)**
- dynamically adds any image as a watermark
- adjust size, location, and opacity
- applies on the 2nd run

**LC Tone Match**

- Designed for Krea2 , Klein_9b, and Qwen Image Edit or ID edit images.
- matches the tone of the image fed to it.
- add an optional mask 🎭 to isolate the effect (shown here using Image desaturate)
- ⚠️ This is specifically designed to overlay two similar images by controlling frequency, not color palette (like a color match node). You can control the detail radius or blur the mask, but two different images with just overlay each other.
